summary: Claritev Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events to report the death of board member John Prince. No special situation transaction, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine notification of a board member's passing, which does not constitute a special situation. No deal terms or structural changes apply. There is nothing to watch from a risk-arb perspective.
